Help & workflow guide

Why this tool exists, where the data comes from, and how to use it every day.

Why this exists

Every year, good customers quietly go quiet. They're still buying — or they've stopped — and nobody notices until it's too late to do anything about it. A spreadsheet doesn't call anyone. Nothing reminds you who needs a visit this week.

TCST exists to fix exactly that: one shared view of every customer, built from real data, kept alive by what you do every day.

Where the data comes from

Two real sources become one customer view.

Teamleader CRM
Deals, customer type, contact details, and who's responsible for the account.
Monthly Excel file
Revenue by year and product category, updated by your manager every month.
You're not just using this data — you're building it.
Every call, email, visit, and note you log becomes part of the customer's real history.

What the app does with it

Two separate signals decide who needs attention.

Revenue tier
High / Medium / Low, based on how much a customer buys and how recently. Computed live from real turnover data.
Relationship risk
A customer can still be buying — but if nobody's actually talked to them in a while, this flags it separately. Revenue alone would miss that.

Your daily workflow

The loop you follow every day.

1 · Open My Queue
See what's due, overdue, or upcoming - or browse Priority List to find more.
2 · Open the profile
See their full history and what's already planned next.
3 · Log what happened
Called, Emailed, Visited, or just a Note - every real contact counts.
4 · Plan the next step
Schedule a follow-up yourself - or the app will ask you to before you close out.

What the colors mean

Read your queue at a glance.

Overdue 5d — act now Due today Due 07/23 — no rush yet
"Self-scheduled"
You planned this yourself, after a call or visit.
"App-flagged"
The app noticed this customer needs attention and added it for you.

Adding a planned action to your Google Calendar

Any planned action with a due date - in My Queue or on a customer's profile - has a small 📅 Add to calendar link next to it.

Clicking it opens Google Calendar in a new tab with the event already filled in - customer, action, and a link straight back to this exact customer in TCST, so opening the calendar event on the day itself brings you right back here. No login or setup needed, and nothing is added automatically - you choose which ones are worth putting on your calendar.

This is the quick, one-click version. A fully automatic sync (every new action added to your calendar by itself) is planned for later, once TCST has a permanent home online.

What's expected of you

  • Log every real contact - calls, emails, visits, notes. This is now the real record.
  • Always plan the next step - schedule a follow-up, or tell the app none is needed.
  • Check My Queue every day - that's your home page, it shows exactly what's due.
  • Use Priority List to find more - when your queue is clear, go looking for who needs a call.
  • Track your own progress - My Progress shows your streak and what you've completed.

Real customers. Real conversations. Nothing forgotten.

Part 2 of 2 · one-off, on demand

Build & distribute a custom list

A completely separate tool from Part 1 above. Nothing here touches the live Priority List or its thresholds - this builds one named, versioned list and sends it to exactly the person you pick, only once you click Distribute.

Step 1 - Who receives this list?

A real person, chosen here - not guessed. This is exactly who the list lands with when you click Distribute; nothing gets sent until you pick someone (or use Auto, which only works when the scope below clearly belongs to one territory).

Step 2 - What should it select?

Start broad with territory, then optionally narrow further. Anything left on "All" is ignored.

Data & Refresh

Data overview

A basic integrity check - these numbers should track the Excel sheet and the Teamleader match rate. If a refresh ever produces numbers that look wrong here, something broke upstream.

Refresh history

Every data refresh logged, not just the last few - trends and drops are easier to catch with the full history than a rolling window.

Replaces the Excel data

No new Excel file

Upload replaces the Excel data with a new file - parsed in your browser, merged with existing Teamleader matches/contacts/deals by Klantnummer, and saved live for everyone once you confirm. "Refresh Teamleader data only" (matching brand-new customers, updating deal/contact history) is not built yet - still shows a preview only.
